risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working (worst-case: treat as faulty/needs repair).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or internal damage not visible in photos (pulley, bearings, regulator, brushes).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of any part number/brand marking on the unit (all sides).
Tell the vehicle make/model/year it came from (or engine code) and send a photo of the donor engine bay if available.
Provide a bench test result (output voltage at idle and load) or a short test video.
Show close-ups of pulley/bearing area and any regulator/brush access points.
